issues.problem: No iOS Capacitor project exists; only Android WebView shell under apps/gaadiiq-angular/android.
issues.root: Product scoped Android-only scaffold; ios/ directory never created.
issues.expected: Parity iOS app (Xcode project) with same Capacitor webDir and App Store readiness.

issues.problem: Dual auth stacks: Angular uses Supabase Auth; FastAPI uses RS256 JWT. Mobile UI does not obtain FastAPI tokens, so many API routes (payments, loans inquiries, notifications, diagnosis history) are unreachable or broken from the app.
issues.root: Two parallel backends evolved without a unified session bridge.
issues.expected: Single identity: either Supabase JWT validated by API, or mobile uses FastAPI login and stores secure tokens.

issues.problem: No Razorpay checkout wired in Angular despite API /payments/* and marketing copy claiming UPI/cards/EMI via Razorpay.
issues.root: Payments implemented server-side only; pricing-plans is FAQ/static.
issues.expected: End-to-end checkout: create order → Razorpay SDK → verify → unlock plan/listing.

issues.problem: Capacitor app is a bare WebView wrap: no Camera, Geolocation, Push, Preferences, or Filesystem plugins; package.json has no cap sync/run scripts.
issues.expected: Native plugins for camera, location, push, secure storage; npm scripts for sync/build.

issues.problem: android:allowBackup="true" allows ADB backup of WebView data including localStorage (wishlist, journey, possibly session fragments).
issues.expected: allowBackup=false; exclude sensitive paths; disable cleartext.

issues.problem: No SSL/certificate pinning and no Network Security Config; MITM on user devices possible for API/Supabase traffic.
issues.root: No pinning library or network_security_config.xml beyond defaults.
issues.expected: Pin api.gaadiiq.com + Supabase host; fail closed on mismatch in release builds.

issues.problem: GET /diagnosis/{id} is unauthenticated → IDOR: anyone with UUID can read another user's diagnosis (vehicle + symptoms).
issues.root: get_diagnosis has no Depends(get_current_user) or ownership check.
issues.expected: Require auth; allow owner or admin only.

issues.problem: User-controlled text interpolated into LLM prompts with no sanitisation/injection fence — prompt injection risk; HLD claims sanitisation but code lacks it.
issues.root: f-string prompt assembly in diagnosis.py / valuation.py / sentiment.py.
issues.expected: Input length limits, delimiter fencing, instruction hierarchy, output schema validation, refusal tests.

issues.problem: OTP / phone SMS authentication does not exist. Register may collect phone but AuthService.register() never uses verifyOtp.
issues.expected: Phone OTP via Supabase or MSG91/Twilio for India primary mobile UX.

issues.problem: App uses navigator.geolocation but AndroidManifest declares only INTERNET — no ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / COARSE.
issues.root: Web API used without native permission declarations/plugins.
issues.expected: Add permissions + @capacitor/geolocation with runtime prompts.

issues.problem: ApiService.submitLoanInquiry hits /loans/inquiry but API exposes /loans/inquiries — broken loan lead capture.
issues.expected: Align client path; add contract test.

issues.problem: sellerGuard is client-side only. FastAPI dealer endpoints use soft Dealer-row checks; any user can POST /dealers/register. Role enums diverge (seller vs dealer).
issues.root: No unified server-side role enforcement aligned with Angular.
issues.expected: Unified roles; require_role on sensitive routes; adminGuard.

issues.problem: No insurance enquiry API or partner quote flow; only client-side premium estimates / marketing.
issues.expected: POST insurance lead + partner deep-links with disclosure.

issues.problem: Ask GAADIIQ / POST /recommend/ai-chat (SSE) from LLD is not implemented.
issues.expected: Streaming chat endpoint + mobile UI with citations/fallback.

issues.problem: No FCM/APNs Capacitor push plugin; in-app notifications API unused by primary Supabase auth path.
issues.expected: FCM + user tokens; deep links to bookings/price drops.

issues.problem: Angular advisor uses local heuristic scoring; not wired to POST /recommend. Diverges from Next.js advisor.
issues.expected: Call API; method badge; unify scoring; use CityService.

issues.problem: Wishlist, price alerts, recently viewed persist only in localStorage — lost on reinstall, not cross-device.
issues.expected: Authenticated CRUD against API; local cache as offline mirror.

issues.problem: Audio/video/document upload unsupported. List-car uses Cloudinary unsigned preset (abuse risk). Upload MIME allowlist only; vision may fetch arbitrary image_urls (SSRF).
issues.root: No magic bytes/AV; unsigned Cloudinary; unrestricted vision URLs.
issues.expected: Magic bytes, size caps, AV scan, signed uploads, SSRF allowlist.

issues.problem: SlowAPI rate limits disabled unless environment==production; diagnosis/analyse not limited; /metrics public.
issues.expected: Enable limits in staging; rate-limit diagnosis; protect /metrics.

issues.problem: customer_activities/intent_scores FK columns String(36) vs UUID PKs; vehicle_diagnoses.user_id nullable without FK.
issues.expected: UUID FKs with ON DELETE SET NULL/CASCADE; backfill.

issues.problem: Default allowed_origins is localhost:3000; Capacitor/Android and Angular :4200 may be blocked against production API.
issues.root: CORS not listing mobile/web production origins.
issues.expected: Explicit allowlist: web, capacitor origins, staging.

issues.problem: Only 1 Angular unit spec (boilerplate broken); no Appium/Detox against Capacitor; Android instrumented tests still Capacitor sample package names.
issues.expected: Contract tests + critical-path Appium; fix sample tests; CI on PR.

issues.problem: Dual-range slider: WebKit thumb misalignment (no margin-top), no z-index swap when thumbs overlap, track not clickable.
issues.expected: Centered thumbs, dynamic z-index, accessible labels.

issues.problem: showAllIndiaBanner requires !allIndiaOverride so amber banner never shows after auto-override for empty cities.
issues.expected: Show banner when override active.

issues.problem: New Cars P0 fixes (Above ₹30L applyBudget) live on cursor/fix-new-cars-module-85e1 and are NOT merged into Claude tip.
issues.expected: Merge/cherry-pick fix branch.

issues.problem: No dedicated EV calculator screen; TCO service exists but weak mobile discovery.
issues.expected: EV cost/range calculator page; TCO entry from car detail.

issues.problem: No dealer directory search; service booking only opens maps to static SERVICE_CENTERS; no service history.
issues.expected: Dealer search API+UI; booking persistence; history.

issues.problem: Sparse ARIA; many outline:none without :focus-visible; no TalkBack/VoiceOver pass; contrast not systematically verified.
issues.expected: WCAG 2.2 AA on top flows.

issues.problem: Listing grids without virtual scroll; no measured startup/FPS/memory on device.
issues.expected: Virtual scroll, image sizing, WebView metrics.

issues.problem: No true offline mode; SW precaches shell only; forms fail opaquely offline; no queue/retry.
issues.expected: Offline banner, queued mutations, read-through cache.

issues.problem: Bank rates are hardcoded stubs; client EMI not using GET /loans/emi-calculator.
issues.expected: Disclose indicative; sync API calculator.

issues.problem: Public sentiment track endpoint forgeable; no customer consent UX.
issues.expected: Consent, auth-only tracking, disclosure.

issues.problem: minSdk 24 but product asks Android 12+ validation; foldable/tablet/landscape untested; no iPad.
issues.expected: Document and execute supported device matrix.

issues.problem: Instrumented tests still reference com.getcapacitor.myapp / ExampleUnitTest.
issues.expected: Replace with GAADIIQ smoke or remove from CI.

issues.problem: No AI Advisor CTA when filters yield 0 results; no URL write-back for filters.
issues.expected: Advisor link + query sync.

issues.problem: API /diagnosis/history exists but Angular wizard has no history UI.
issues.expected: Past diagnoses list with reopen.

issues.problem: No root/jailbreak detection or Play Integrity on release builds.
issues.expected: Play Integrity / DeviceCheck gated for payments.

issues.problem: .env.example documents HS256 SECRET_KEY while API uses RS256 PEMs.
issues.expected: Align examples with JWT key files.

issues.problem: When Razorpay keys unset, webhook verification may be open — dangerous if mis-deployed.
issues.expected: Fail closed without keys outside local dev.

issues.problem: No dedicated Settings/Profile edit screen; no DPDP delete-account flow.
issues.expected: Profile, notification prefs, privacy, delete account.
